served_by: BonfyreWebAddress, rendering the live /_surface/ pattern catalogue
shape: one page, four territories, six modes: the host decides the territory and .life and .work each carry two internal worlds rather than becoming separate products
projection_claim: the four patterns read one content type and project different field sets over the same subjects; The Foundry Room appears in each with a different set of fields, not as four records

observed_2026_09_04.work: 403 surface-denied — authority-gated, needs an admitted session
observed_2026_09_04.work.business: capital-routes, capital-transformations and funding all serve; the plane orders transformations by reversibility and marks a transform blocked when a funding requirement it names is unresolved

forbidden_inference: an offered verb -> an authorized action; the action layer is an affordance and Authority gates at effect time
a rendered record -> a reservation, an offer accepted, or a completed sale
a refused projection -> an absent subject; night-work answers 403 because .work records need an admitted session, and the same subjects are projected in three other territories
a withheld pane -> a broken one; htmx does not swap on 4xx, so a surface that only sets hx-get reports loading forever instead of offering the session that would fill it
a capacity note -> current occupancy; it is what the venue published, at the time it published it
watching a room -> a plan, an obligation, or anybody expecting you
a mode -> a separate product; .life and .work each carry two internal worlds over one Matrix subject rather than a fifth territory
an unbuilt mode -> an unbuilt territory; household is declared and empty while personal is served from the same host
a capital route -> available capital; capacity_state is what the route reported about itself
a funding requirement -> funding; its state and cannot_infer field say what it is not
an installed app -> a business capability; business mode is a reachability plane over capital routes and transformations, and an inventory of doctypes answers no question a decision rests on

household.label: Household
household.state: unbuilt — no household pattern is served; the mode is declared and empty

business.label: Business
business.state: served — rendered as a capital reachability plane: transformations placed on the axis of what undoing them costs, each carrying its route capacity_state, its unmet prerequisites and its horizon

verb_rule: a mode's verbs are a subset of its territory's; a mode never carries a verb the territory does not, and the union of a territory's modes need not exhaust it
requires_authority: none; resolution is eligibility and grants nothing

lineage.note: borrows nothing. Every donor is one product with one domain, and nothing in the reference estate is shaped like one subject seen four ways.
